sources.entry: Franz AI - A Chrome extension to rewrite text using OpenAI API. #free

summary.name: Franz AI Text Rewriter
summary.one_liner: A Chrome extension that rewrites selected text on any webpage using the OpenAI API and previews the result in place.
use_cases: rephrase writing with AI in the browser
rewrite selected text via right-click menu
summary.what_it_does: The extension lets users select text on any webpage, right-click, and choose a rewriting option from the context menu. The rewritten text is shown in place for preview. It uses AI models named on the page, GPT-3.5 Turbo and GPT-4, via the OpenAI API. The page advertises 10k free rewrites per user. The listing shows version 1.0.6, last updated May 22, 2023, and a size of 22.44 KiB. The developer declares it does not sell data or use it for unrelated purposes.
notable: Right-click context menu rewriting of selected text on any webpage
Uses GPT-3.5 Turbo and GPT-4 via the OpenAI API
caveats: Relies on the OpenAI API, so it needs an OpenAI service connection (key requirements not stated on the page)
Last updated May 22, 2023; may be outdated
Developer is a non-trader, so EU consumer rights do not apply
